product_one_liner.value: Luminance's Contract Intelligence platform uses legal-grade AI to draft, negotiate, analyze, and manage contracts for legal and business teams across enterprises.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes Contract Intelligence for the enterprise; the company funding announcement describes specialist AI automating contract generation, negotiation, and post-execution analysis.

pricing_page.notes: The official homepage navigation offers a demo rather than pricing, and the complete footer navigation lists platform, resources, company, careers, contact, and legal links without a pricing link; this supports a negative answer.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Luminance’s official customer stories page lists TRENCH GROUP and IMERYS as customer examples. | named_customers.0: TRENCH GROUP is named on Luminance’s customer stories page. | named_customers.1: IMERYS is named on Luminance’s customer stories page.

employee_band.notes: The Luminance LinkedIn company profile identifies company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company profile identifies Cambridge as Luminance’s headquarters. | hq_country: The Luminance LinkedIn company profile gives its country as the United Kingdom and locality as Cambridge.

founded_year.notes: The company About excerpt states it was founded by mathematicians in 2015.

eng_blog.notes: Two official blog posts meet the technical threshold: the June 2026 Luna Crescent post is by the Co-Founder and Director of AI and discusses model development and R&D validation; the October 2026 model-selection post is by Luc Frachon and the Luminance Evals Team and explains engineering evaluation of models for product tasks.

public_docs.notes: Luminance provides a public API documentation portal, identifies a REST API for integrating with its platform, and includes developer-facing authentication and endpoint documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: A current listing identifies a Machine Learning Research Engineer role and says it was confirmed live in the last 24 hours.

model_provider.value: Luminance says it uses its proprietary Luna Crescent legal model together with task-selected foundation models; its Trust Center names OpenAI as a generative-model provider.
model_provider.notes: Luminance describes Luna Crescent as its proprietary legal model within a multi-model system that also selects foundation models; its Trust Center explicitly names OpenAI, LLC as a generative model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The official Trust Center compliance list names GDPR, SOC 2 Type II, and ISO 27001:2022. | compliance_certs.0: The Trust Center compliance list names GDPR. | compliance_certs.1: The Trust Center compliance list names SOC 2 Type II. | compliance_certs.2: The Trust Center compliance list names ISO 27001:2022.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The official funding announcement calls the $75 million round a Series C; the funding profile reports it as the latest round. | funding_date: The official Series C announcement is dated February 18, 2025, and the funding profile identifies it as the latest round, yielding 2025-02. | funding_amount_usd: The company announcement gives a $75 million Series C; the funding profile identifies that as the latest round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest reported round was February 18, 2025, which predates the 18-month lookback window ending November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A current Business Development Representative/Sales Development Representative listing is marked confirmed live in the last 24 hours.

launched_6mo.notes: Luminance published its October 2026 product-update announcement on November 9, 2026; the page describes nine new innovations, including capabilities marked live, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Luminance announced Greg Pelander’s appointment as Chief Technology Officer in March 2026, inside the 12-month lookback period.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: A Luminance job posting explicitly says partner activity is documented in HubSpot, supporting HubSpot as a visible CRM system. | crm_stack_signal.0: The job posting names HubSpot.
